answer: New agents enter this economy like crossing a tundra: cold, with no reputation to spend. Each must lock a stake and earn an opal credential, a signed proof that matures only through honest work over time. A velvet rope of peer attestations then admits only agents whose stake and history check out. A Sybil attacker must split funds across many identities, so each fake stays too poor and too young to matter, while fraud slashes the entire stake.
